entries.text: Hi, this is Sarah calling about the ICU nurse role. This call is recorded. Is now a good time?
Yeah, I mean, sure, I was just, yeah go ahead.
Which state is your RN license in, and is it currently active?
So I was licensed in Ohio, well, actually it started in Kentucky but I transferred it to Ohio, um, but honestly it lapsed back in March, I've been meaning to renew it.
How many years of ICU experience do you have?
Twelve years, well, eleven if you don't count the float pool.
